Markets.title: Copper stays range bound as US tariff uncertainty, oil inflation risks weigh
Markets.summary: Copper prices remained range-bound due to cautious trading caused by US tariff uncertainty and oil inflation risks. While a Chinese scrap shortage supported demand, record-high US inventories and Goldman Sachs' long-term outlook of $15,400 a ton by 2027 shaped market sentiment.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets plummeted on Monday, with the Sensex falling nearly 900 points and the Nifty dropping below 22,900. The sell-off wiped out nearly Rs 5 lakh crore in market value due to private bank selling, weak global cues, and earnings uncertainty.

Markets.title: Aerospace and military contractors raise 2026 profit forecasts
Markets.summary: Northrop Grumman and RTX raised their 2026 profit forecasts due to strong military demand and record backlogs. GE Aerospace also performed well, though it warned of potential demand declines from high fuel prices.

Markets.title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet: McGeever
Markets.summary: Emerging markets are showing unexpected economic resilience despite the Federal Reserve's tightening policies. Stronger fiscal fundamentals and high bond yields are giving these countries more flexibility, with some even considering rate cuts.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks gain as healthcare stocks hit record high, oil prices fall
Markets.summary: US stocks rose as a rally in healthcare stocks reached record highs and falling oil prices helped the market recover from the previous week's tech sell-off. Investors digested mixed corporate earnings reports from major companies like General Motors, Steel Dynamics, 3M, and Equifax while awaiting further financial results.

Markets.title: Hilton to move stock listing to Nasdaq
Markets.summary: Hilton Worldwide is moving its stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq starting November 5. The company chose Nasdaq because its focus on technology aligns with Hilton's current growth and innovation strategy.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that U.S. intelligence sharing is functioning properly following discussions with a U.S. envoy in Oslo. This development follows a prior dispute in which Ukraine accused Washington of withholding critical intelligence, an accusation Washington strongly rejected.

Geo-Political.title: Marseille braces for more unrest after protests give way to 'apocalyptic' disorder
Geo-Political.summary: France's second-largest city, Marseille, is preparing for additional disturbances following severe violence and chaos on Saturday. The unrest in Marseille was part of wider nationwide protests that resulted in significant disorder across France.

Geo-Political.title: Man charged with attack on Australian MP as suspect's father says she is family friend
Geo-Political.summary: Brendan Nugent has been charged with attacking Australian MP Helen Haines, leaving her in a critical condition. Nugent's father stated that their family has known Haines as a friend for over 20 years.

Geo-Political.title: 'Great result for Canada', says Carney as Alberta votes to reject separatism
Geo-Political.summary: Alberta voters rejected separatism in a provincial vote, choosing to remain part of Canada. Mark Carney praised the outcome as a great result for the country, though deep political divisions remain.

Geo-Political.title: North Korea publishes photos of Kim Jong Un - why do rumours of his death keep coming back?
Geo-Political.summary: North Korean state media released photos of leader Kim Jong Un with his daughter to dispel recent unsubstantiated rumors of his death. Similar rumors about his health have repeatedly surfaced due to the secretive nature of the regime and his occasional absences from public view.

Geo-Political.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say
Geo-Political.summary: Sudan army drone strikes targeted a funeral truck and a fuel market, killing more than 300 people. The military reportedly struck the market because it was allegedly supplying fuel to the Rapid Support Forces (RSF).

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help creators improve their digital content in 2025. These technologies aim to simplify the creation process and help digital creators maintain a competitive edge.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audience. Because numerous tools are available on the market, choosing the right one for your specific needs can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network operates and how users can earn money through its platform. The article also provides a list of top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers to common questions.

Data & Insights.title: The changing template of global growth—and what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Although the global economy showed resilience in 2026, ongoing volatility and unpredictability persist. These global economic challenges could negatively impact India's future growth trajectory.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: India's free trade agreement with New Zealand will take effect on October 20, granting Indian exports full duty-free access. The pact aims to increase bilateral trade to approximately ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
Data & Insights.summary: India has attracted ₹1.64 lakh crore in investments for 12 semiconductor projects across six states. Gujarat has emerged as the largest hub with six approved projects, including a ₹91,526 crore fabrication plant by Tata-PSMC.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: No tariff on Indian exports from Oct 20; Textile, pharma, leather exports to gain market access
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 20, the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement will eliminate all tariffs on Indian exports to New Zealand. This agreement is expected to enhance market access and competitiveness for Indian sectors such as textiles, leather, and pharmaceuticals.

Data & Insights.title: Is India’s solar power play facing its Icarus moment?
Data & Insights.summary: India's rapid growth in solar power is overwhelming its current electricity grid infrastructure. The government must address these grid bottlenecks to prevent them from disrupting the country's clean energy goals.

Data & Insights.title: FM Sitharaman flags global capital moving towards US, AI-linked markets as a ‘concern’ for India in 2027
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman warned that capital outflows and global investments shifting toward the US and AI-linked markets pose major risks to India in 2027. She highlighted this trend as a significant concern for the country's financial stability.

India.title: Delhi Police Transfers CJP Leaders' Case To Crime Branch Ahead Of Hearing
India.summary: Delhi Police has transferred two cases involving CJP leaders Das and Ranka to the Crime Branch. The latest transfer comes ahead of an upcoming court hearing regarding the leaders allegedly entering the Jantar Mantar area.

India.title: 4 More People, Including 2 Women, Arrested In Tiger Shroff Shooting Case
India.summary: Four more people, including two women, have been arrested in connection with a shooting case involving actor Tiger Shroff. Radha and Babita were apprehended at the New Delhi Railway Station, while Kunal and Sumit were arrested in Sonipat, Haryana.

India.title: Ex-AAP Sarpanch Arrested In Punjab Over Links To Cop Caught With 15 kg Heroin
India.summary: A former Aam Aadmi Party sarpanch has been arrested in Punjab for his alleged connections to a policeman. The arrested constable, assigned to the Punjab Police anti-drone unit, was previously caught in possession of 15 kilograms of heroin.

India.title: "We're About As Close As You Can Be": Marco Rubio On India-US Trade Deal
India.summary: US Senator Marco Rubio stated that India and the American nation are very close to reaching a trade deal during wide-ranging talks with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar in Mumbai. These discussions occurred despite bilateral tensions over unpredictable US trade policies and tightening immigration rules.

India.title: 'Thank You For Free Publicity': Abhijeet Dipke On Cockroach Effigy In Delhi
India.summary: A Delhi Ramlila committee burned a cockroach effigy, claiming it promoted cleanliness campaigns like Swachh Bharat by symbolizing filth. However, the internet and Abhijeet Dipke believed the effigy was actually a direct dig at a pressure group.

India.title: Finance Influencer With 1.3 Million Followers Dies By Suicide, Father Claims Cyberbullying
India.summary: V Harish, a 24-year-old Indian finance influencer known as 'Finance With Harish,' died by suicide. His father stated that the death was a result of intense cyberbullying.

General.title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran intelligence after RAF Fairford incident
General.summary: Two men have been re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iranian intelligence following an incident at RAF Fairford. The head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing stated that Iranian state involvement in the matter is considered highly likely.

General.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that United States intelligence sharing is functioning properly following discussions with a U.S. envoy in Oslo. Previously, Ukraine alleged that Washington was withholding essential intelligence, an accusation that U.S. officials strongly rejected.

General.title: Government failings allowed Covid 'to spread like wildfire' in care homes, inquiry finds
General.summary: A government Covid inquiry report found that official failings allowed the virus to spread rapidly through care homes. The investigation specifically criticized inadequate personal protective equipment and unsafe hospital discharge practices.

General.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
General.summary: A Google cloud outage caused technical issues for various websites and banking services in the UK. Digital bank Revolut was among the hardest hit, leaving many customers temporarily unable to access their accounts.

General.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
General.summary: The BBC is closing the BBC Three, BBC Scotland, and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels. These closures are part of the corporation's efforts to save £500 million over two years.

General.title: Harry says he wants to 'reconcile' with his family
General.summary: Prince Harry stated in a New York magazine interview last month that he wants to reconcile with his royal family. The Duke of Cornwall made these comments regarding his family relationships during his visit.
